title: People chat with two agents: an @mention as the object of a request to the other agent wakes no turn; a direct ask is answered; multi-mention answers only the addressed (#1926 m01–m04 + silence guard)
regression: #1926 (mention_role: object/referenced → no turn; silence is never a message) — m01/m02 object quiet, m03 asked replies, m04 multi-mention only the addressed; the guard: no 'staying silent' bubble ever; #1926 m01–m04 (lane-a half verified on 0.1.155); run 9 re-graded PASS on all four turns from the full replay (#2069 artefact); AFTER on #2110's judge (0.1.177): m02 '@lane-b can you communicate directly with @lane-a?' → lane-a answered as well (BEFORE: quiet). Not the judge (it scored lane-a 0.02, lane-b 0.95 and chose lane-b): lane-b's reply text contained '@lane-a' and agentd dispatched that agent bubble as a send to lane-a → #2207 (agent-reply mention becomes a send). Turn 2 is the regression case for #2207: lane-b answers, lane-a has no row; #2207 verified on 0.1.179 (run 12: all four turns PASS, lane-a no row on t2); #2274 (run 13, 0.1.185: t1 m01 — judge chosen=[] yet lane-a replied 80 ms later; t2–t4 right); run 15: failed at 15:58:41 (#2274), before the stray m1 run overlapped lane a

turns.note: m01: nobody is addressed (lane-a is the object, lane-b not mentioned) — lane-a must stay quiet; whether lane-b answers is the Jev decision, not asserted

turns.prompt: @lane-a and @lane-b are both here — @lane-b, what is 7 × 6? Just the number.

doc_checks.forbid_text_regex: (?i)(staying (silent|quiet)|that (question|one) is for|nothing to add from me|i'?ll let \w+ take this)

notes: Run 8 (0.1.155): lane-b was never added (harness key bug: 'lane-b' vs 'b'), so only the lane-a half was measured — quiet on m01/m02/m04 and 81 on m03, no silence bubble. Fixed; the 'addressed agent answered' half is first measured in run 9. Run 9 (0.1.163): lane-b added; m02 and m04 → lane-b answered, lane-a quiet; m03 → 81; m01 → both quiet (nobody addressed).
